[[Blind Faith]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = NoneWhile the modifier itself has no reward boost, it does apply [[Mutation]] which does actually boost rewards by 20%. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Towers gain stun immunity, enemies gain mutation modifier.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Temperance''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it will add the [[Mutation]] modifier and make towers stun immune. ==Effects== When applied, the [[Mutation]] modifier will get applied. This will boost rewards by 20% and increase the [[Shield Health]] of enemies by 2.5% every wave after their debut. As this only starts once the [[Mutation]] is applied, how much health enemies will gain is entirely dependent on what wave it is activated on. If it is activated on Wave 5, most enemies will end up affected by it, though if activated on Wave 20, it will have no effect as it is the last wave. To compensate, all towers become stun immune. ==Trivia== *'''Temperance''' is based on the [[wp:Temperance (tarot card)|Temperance]] tarot card. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Temperance''' added. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **[[Mutation]] nerfed from 5% to 2.5%. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[V1.80.0|v1.80.1d]] ** '''Temperance''' removed. ==Notes== {{ModifierNavBox}}
